name: Royal Danish Academy – Architecture, Design, Conservation
about: The Royal Danish Academy is Denmark's national school of architecture, design and conservation, based in Copenhagen. Its one English-taught first degree is not in Copenhagen: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is taught in the glass and ceramics workshops in Nexø on Bornholm, a Baltic island reached from Copenhagen by train and ferry. The whole intake is decided by admission tests, not grades.
ibNotes: No page read for this institution mentions DP Course Results. The canonical Opportunities apply the national rule (ev-ufsn-ib-course-results): Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 in all six subjects and three at HL, give access to AP and professional bachelor programmes.

deadlines.label: Application (IB and all international qualifications)
deadlines.notes: Through optagelse.dk, which opens on 1 February.

sources.title: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics lasts 3 years and 3 months. The whole intake is through quota 2, with two admission tests (one online, one on the Copenhagen campus). About 16 students start each year; there were 159 applicants in 2024 and 136 in 2025.
Crafts in Glass and Ceramics is a professional bachelor programme taught in English on Bornholm.
An IB counts as equivalent to a Danish stx. Apart from English B, there are no subject, level or grade-average requirements.
Applicants need English at Danish B level. An IB meets it with English B at SL or higher; otherwise TOEFL, IELTS Academic 6.5 or Cambridge C1/C2 at 180. No dispensation is possible.

The Crafts programme is taught in Nexø on Bornholm, but the second admission test and interview take place on the Academy's campus in Copenhagen.
Grades play no part in admission. The whole intake goes through quota 2, and places go to the highest scorers in two admission tests.

programmes.name: Crafts in Glass and Ceramics
programmes.summary: An artistic and entrepreneurial professional bachelor in glass and ceramics, taught in the workshops in Nexø on Bornholm. It lasts 3 years and 3 months, with about 16 places a year. Grades do not decide admission: an online test with a mini portfolio, then a test and interview in Copenhagen, do.
programmes.requirementsText: A number of internationally recognized exams of the type "Baccalaureat" (like IB and EB) are considered equivalent to a Danish "stx" (3-year high school), and we have no further requirements regarding contents and level of subjects apart from English at level B. [...] IB English B (SL).
extraRequirements: English at B level (IB English B at SL or higher counts), or an accepted English test
An online admission test with a mini portfolio, then a test and interview in Copenhagen if invited
16 study places and one standby place. 159 applicants in 2024 and 136 in 2025.
